title: mitmproxy 12.2.3 macOS ARM64
redistribution: Pinned official standalone bundle, unchanged. Full source/lockfile closure, 525 checksum-verified Rust crate sources, Git and Swift dependencies, exact CPython/native library sources and full available source notices are retained. Rust sources include an explicit build/test/other-platform superset. Missing standalone crate notices preserve original upstream metadata and attribution plus standard reference terms, without invented copyright statements. The wrapper uses only typed mitmdump HTTP capture/read APIs with private profile configuration, loopback endpoints and no system proxy or trust installation. Native public CLI and independent model gates are recorded separately.
